[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Djirra''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Logistics officer/Legends|logistics officer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] invaded [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], Djirra was tasked with researching the [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon freezing]] process.

He had heard the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] talking about Vader threatening [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] with leaving a [[garrison/Legends|garrison]] on the Cloud City, and feared that he would be the one to carry it out. He decided that [[Hugo Treece]] would do for [[Commanding officer/Legends|Commanding officer]] and holding back any unrest, and considered [[Portent]]'s assistance in subjugating the populace.<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
